confidence_levels.high: encoding and operation established by independent checks
confidence_levels.medium: established by a single kind of check; a sign or width may still be open
confidence_levels.format-only: the shape (length, fields) is established but the operation is not: the mnemonic is a family placeholder

meta.unit: the minimum unit is the byte; a stand-alone unit has 2 to 6 bytes, a vector operation 4, a bundle 8; the first byte and, for some first bytes, a prefix of the second decide the length (length_leaves)
meta.packet: { A || B }: the head has bit 7 of its first byte set and is decoded as A' = (unit << 1) | bit7(B); B is decoded with its first byte masked (& 0x7f); the two units execute in parallel; a transfer in B takes the packet start as the base of its displacement; a head whose A' is a control/system form is a masked orphan (the unit decoded with b0 & 0x7f on its own)
meta.bit_numbering: w = big-endian integer of the transformed unit (A' in a packet head; byte 0 & 0x7f in a B slot or an orphan), bit 0 = LSB of the last byte; bit 7 of byte 0 is never part of a mask
meta.form_order: within one length the first alternative whose (w & mask) == value matches wins; the list is ordered by specificity
meta.operand: pieces = [lo, width] bit pieces (the first is the most significant); value = (signed ? sext : raw) * scale + bias; register kinds r5 (r0-r31), r4 (r0-r15), r4p (r1-r16), r3p (r1-r8), csr, acc; a const operand is a value of the alternative
meta.esil: {name} read, {=name} write, {#name} decimal value, {d} target, {ret} return address after the delay slots, {mask} of a bit-field width; null = no semantics, "" = no architectural effect; hypothetical = the reading of a provisional name or of an open sign
meta.length_leaves: [b0 & 0x7f, depth, prefix of the top depth bits of b1, label]; label > 0: length in bytes, label < 0: masked orphan of -label bytes; the deepest matching leaf wins; unit = stand-alone units and B slots, head = packet heads (A')
meta.delay_slots: slots = instructions (packets included) executed after a transfer or before the body of a loop
